semantic_fragments.content: For clause 15.4.3.1 Battery Housing, the Risk Management assessment references Risk Management Report DN: PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0. ISO 14971 clause 5.2 covers intended use and identification of characteristics related to safety issues (Verdict: P). Clause 5.3 covers hazard analysis (Verdict: P). Clause 5.4 covers risk estimation (Verdict: P). Overall verdict for Battery Housing is Pass (P).

Multiple clauses under IEC60601-1 clause 15 are marked N/A, including: 15.4.2.1c (Independent non-SELF-RESETTING THERMAL CUT-OUT), 15.4.2.1d (Loss of function of ME EQUIPMENT), 15.4.2.1h (ME EQUIPMENT with tubular heating elements), 15.4.3.2 (Connection), 15.4.3.3 (Protection against overcharging), 15.4.4 (Indicators), 15.4.5 (Pre-set controls), and 15.4.6 (actuating parts of controls – torque & axial pull tests). These are not applicable to the device under test.
